quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q: as of June 30, 2026 the product backlog, excluding service contracts, was $6,945,252 - $5,172,502 of purchase orders received and $1,772,750 of projects where the customer's internal approval is complete, financial resources are allocated and the customer has made a firm verbal commitment - versus $6,215,443 (all purchase orders) at June 30, 2025. Q2 2026 chiller revenue was $684,239 versus $2,015,893 (-66.1%) and cogeneration $249,720 versus $1,066,835 (-76.6%); first-half chiller revenue was $1,464,828 versus $3,390,090. Remaining performance obligations were approximately $4,176,508.
